log.text: Root cause found: session_summary's 'no session undefined' happens because the schema requires the model to supply `session`, but Servex already knows it (the session-smart agent's own id is `session-smart-<session id>`) — fix is to derive session from ctx.caller instead of trusting the model. Scope locked from owner addenda: (1) tool fix, session derived not model-supplied; (2) a Servex-level rename_session tool (folder move, id stays key, summary file + sessions.json + ai/log.jsonl updated, no general ref-tracker, best-effort follower ping); (3) session-smart.md gets one short generic paragraph: rename within a couple of prompts once topic is clear; (4) proposal/accept-reject card is OUT of scope this task — just make sure the rename tool is callable by a future proposal; (5) fallback label for untitled rows = the voice id (not content-based) per owner's latest word, dropdown button shows current session's own name; (6) switcher refetches recent_project on open, keeps stale rows visible meanwhile, still excludes the tab's own session. NOT building: the switch-session-button/current-row-highlight change — fixer-1 (from v-sq8y7db) already has that in ux/Dictate/chat.js; will rebase onto it before merge. Reading Sessions.js session_path/folder layout next, then building in a worktree.

Built in worktree 'session-names' (C:\Code\lew42\worktrees\session-names): (1) tools.js derives `session` from the caller's own agent id (session-smart-<id>) instead of trusting the model, for session_summary and session_line; (2) Sessions.js gets rename(s,title)/rename_session() — slugifies the title (reusing Server/session-migrate.mjs's slugify, same convention as the 2026-10-08 migration), git-mv's or fs.renames the folder, updates s.file + sessions.json, best-effort patches any Follow subs on the old path, pushes a {kind:'renamed'} event on the session's own SSE stream; (3) summarize() calls rename() whenever the title changes, so no second call is needed; (4) session-smart.md's naming instruction rewritten: voice id is the default label, title set once the topic is clear (a couple of turns), not forced on turn one; (5) chat.js session_switcher: click on the switch button now re-runs paint() each time (refetches recent_project), guarded by the existing open_menu.showing() check so an open menu is never torn down mid-read — documented that the current session is deliberately excluded from the list. Existing Sessions.test.mjs: 25/25 pass. Still to do: a focused test for rename() itself, then rebase chat.js onto fixer-1's landed button/title change, then merge.

Added two tests to Sessions.test.mjs for rename()/rename_session(); caught a real bug while writing them: rename_session's return object read `file: s.file` BEFORE calling this.rename(s,title) (object-literal field order), so it reported the stale pre-rename path even though the rename itself worked. Fixed by reading s.file after. 27/27 checks pass now. Checked the Item system for an existing move/rename primitive (owner asked): public/framework/core/Task's verdict verbs (approve/improve/reject) are the existing accept/reject mechanism, but there's no generic Item.move/rename — building one is out of scope here (owner's own fallback instruction), so the session folder rename stays local to Sessions.js; noting the gap for core/Item's own backlog. Next: full Servex test pass, then check git log for fixer-1's chat.js commit and rebase onto it, then merge.

Review back (verdict: fix). Verified the most serious finding myself and it's real: physically moving the session's folder on rename breaks the item-tool path the SAME session was handed once at spawn ('Your session's page (the item tool's path): /framework/ai/sessions/.../<old-name>/' baked into its system prompt for the whole conversation, Sessions.js spawn()'s `where` string) — the renaming agent would lose its own record-keeping path the instant it moved. Also confirmed: page_tools.js's DATED_SESSION route checks fs.existsSync on the literal typed path, so any bookmarked dated-folder url 404s after a move too. This is exactly the risk the owner asked me to report back on if it wasn't simple. Decision: drop the physical folder-move entirely, keep only the title write (ask 1, solid) and add a lightweight retitle (summary.json title + a push('renamed') SSE event so a live client redraws by id, never by path) — matches the owner's own simplest-design word. Ask 3 (voice id as default, not content-based) stands per the owner's later reversal, logged earlier; will note that explicitly in review.md's reply since the reviewer read an earlier addendum. Fixing now.
